estimand_units.required_eirp_dbm: dBm (primary: pooled-miss 90th pct of per-onset req)

provenance.note: D1-D0 differences are in dB, not dBm. Three required-EIRP estimands: (1) required_eirp_dbm = pre-specified unconditional pooled P90; (2) required_eirp_dbm_visible = pooled P90 over forearm-visible onsets; (3) required_eirp_dbm_per_placement_median = per-placement median.
provenance.primary_estimand: pre-specified unconditional pooled miss <= 0.10: 90th percentile of per-onset required EIRP pooled over placements
provenance.secondary_estimand: median over placements of per-placement 10th-percentile requirement
provenance.visible_estimand: pooled miss <= 0.10 over forearm-visible onsets only (forearm_visible from geometry, never from statistics)
provenance.false_alarm_calibration: results/commag/audit_calibration.json; thresholds recalibrated to 1e-3 with 10000000 windows/cell, validated on 1000000 fresh windows/cell; git 0d5f7f9
